capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2014 to 2017, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2017 release, previous (60 Ah) pack: "22 kWh (gross)/19 kWh (net)".

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2014 to 2017, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2017 release: 60 Ah pack 19 kWh net.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2014 to 2017, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2017 release: BMW Home Charger Connect "can precondition the vehicle battery when connected" and the battery can be warmed before starting off (no navigation trigger or DC-charge trigger described). Read as manual/scheduled only; the 2019 page mentions cabin pre-conditioning and battery warming "under certain conditions". Owner may prefer none.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2014 to 2017, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2017 release "50 kW DC fast charging" for the i3 range; the 60 Ah car has the same CCS system. DC was an option on early cars (see port note).
